meta.title: KOOK bot (local rc.5 build)
meta.description: Connect KOOK private messages and allowed channels to local DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 over WebSocket. Configure the Bot Token, workspace and allowed users on this bundle's KOOK settings page. Locally modified from upstream 0.3.4; supports text and image input and sends workspace images to the current chat; approvals remain in DSH. Saving settings stops active KOOK tasks and reconnects the bot.
